counterfactual_missing_items: No mention of yellowish atrophic plaques or telangiectasia typical of necrobiosis lipoidica
No granulomatous infiltrate or necrobiosis of collagen described
Bandlike lymphocytic infiltrate is more suggestive of lichen planus than necrobiosis lipoidica
decisive_items: compact hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and bandlike lymphocyte infiltrate in the superficial dermis
A man in his 60s presented with a 10-year history of a slowly progressive, asymptomatic cutaneous eruption on his left leg.
response.rationale: Only one candidate provided; R1 is the sole option. The raw spans show hyperkeratotic papules and bandlike infiltrate, which are not classic for necrobiosis lipoidica, but no alternative candidate is available for comparison.
